The app allows you to read the phone call scripts in advance, and with pauses that allow you to communicate with Santa your little one will believe that good old Saint Nicholas really is on the other end of the phone!

Recently updated with customisation options, 10 additional Call Santa scripts and some other great Christmas features!

- Real Santa phone call voice acting!
- Realistic phone call interface
- Unlimited use
- NEW additional scripts including topics such as homework, getting to bed on time, brushing your teeth and finishing your meals.

**Make sure that your phone isn't set to silent - you won't be able to hear Santa!
